name: TAU Spatial Sound Events 2019
description: TAU Spatial Sound Events 2019 is a benchmark dataset for Sound Event Localization and Detection (SELD) curated for DCASE 2019 Challenge Task 3 by Tampere University. It comprises 500 one-minute spatial audio recordings synthesizing moving and stationary sound events from 11 distinct acoustic classes within realistic reverberant indoor soundscapes, available in both first-order Ambisonics and tetrahedral microphone formats.
